_comment: Museum stock: Museum Tokens are earned by donating artefacts (ArchaeologyManager). Keys are entry ids; grant_items are real item ids; 'gp' is optional.

museum_shards.name: Curio: Verdant Shards
museum_shards.description: A display case of binding shards, quietly redirected to the workshop.

museum_stardust.name: Curio: Gilded Stardust
museum_stardust.description: Sifted from a donor's telescope. The Starreading terrace will take it.

museum_glyph.name: Curio: Glyph Hoard
museum_glyph.description: Refined essence, catalogued and condemned to the stores.

museum_prismatic.name: Curio: Prismatic Splinters
museum_prismatic.description: Too pretty to grind, too useful to keep. Five splinters.

museum_wyrmsteel.name: Curio: Wyrmsteel Offcuts
museum_wyrmsteel.description: Offcuts from a commissioned plate, stamped by the museum's smith.

museum_purse.name: Patron's Purse
museum_purse.description: The museum pays its patrons in coin when it runs out of things to display.

museum_seed_crate.name: Curio: Allotment Seed Crate
museum_seed_crate.description: Seeds pressed into the pages of a donated almanac. Still viable, somehow.

museum_gems.name: Curio: Jeweller's Tray
museum_gems.description: Stones prised from a collection nobody will miss.

museum_saplings.name: Curio: Arboretum Cuttings
museum_saplings.description: Rooted cuttings from the museum's courtyard trees.

museum_umbral.name: Curio: Umbral Reliquary
museum_umbral.description: A sealed box that hums at night. The curator wants it gone.

museum_herald.name: Curio: Herald's Tithe
museum_herald.description: Ingots and essence from the throne's own treasury, recovered at great cost.

museum_old_growth.name: Curio: Old-Growth Seedlings
museum_old_growth.description: Saplings of trees that no longer grow wild anywhere.

museum_echoes.name: Curio: Archive of Echoes
museum_echoes.description: Five recordings so clean the archivists refuse to play them.

museum_gates.name: Curio: Sealed Gates
museum_gates.description: Three folded passages from the Wayfolders' vault. Knock first.
